interfaces.note: A0–A2 share pins with ROW2–ROW0: open = 0 (internal pull-low), 1 = 39 kΩ and a diode to COM0/AD (p. 22, 27). Boards set them with solder jumpers; give parts[].address for a jumpered board.

notes.text: Operating voltage 4.5–5.5 V only; SDA/SCL VIH is 0.7·VDD (3.5 V at 5 V), above an ESP32's 3.3 V output: use an I²C level shifter (e.g. PCA9306/BSS138) between a 3.3 V ESP bus and a 5 V HT16K33.
notes.evidence: VIH Input high Voltage 5 SDA, SCL 0.7VDD — VDD V

notes.text: Logic current without LED load: typ 1 mA, max 2 mA; standby max 10 µA. The LED current comes on top (ROW source up to 40 mA, COM sink 200 mA typ, p. 5).
notes.evidence: IDD Operating Current 5 No load, normal operation, INT/ROW bit is set to “0” — 1 2 mA

notes.text: Address pins: floating A2–A0 read 0; a 39 kΩ resistor and a diode to COM0/AD read 1.

notes.text: 0x70–0x77 is also the range of the TCA9548A I²C mux and of the PCA9685 LED All Call (0x70, on after power-up): see mod.address_conflict and mod.address_reserved.
Many 8x8/14-segment backpacks run the HT16K33 at 3.3 V, below the specified 4.5 V minimum; some carry 10 kΩ I²C pull-ups to VCC.

filter capacitor between VDD and GND close to the chip; the datasheet gives no value

notes.text: DIO is an N-channel open-drain output while data are output; it needs an external pull-up to VCC (1–10 kΩ).
Dynamic supply current at most 5 mA without load and with the display off; the LED current comes on top (GRID sink up to 200 mA, power dissipation 400 mW, p. 14).
At VDD 5 V the input threshold 0.7·VDD is 3.5 V, above an ESP32's output high. Run the TM1638 at 3.3 V (inside the 3–6 V operating range) or buffer STB/CLK/DIO.

notes.text: RESX low pulse at least 10 µs.
Wait 5 ms after releasing RESX before sending commands; Sleep Out not within 120 ms.

3.3 V logic only: VDDI max 3.7 V (abs. 4.6 V) and inputs max VDDI + 0.3 V. 1.44"/1.8" breakouts usually add a regulator on VCC (VDD = VDDI = 3.3 V) and a backlight pin (LED/BL), but do not level-shift CS, A0/DC, SDA, SCK and RESET.
Breakout pin names: CS = CSX, A0 or DC = D/CX, SDA = SDA, SCK/SCL = SCL, RESET/RST = RESX.
Boards sold as 'ST7735' may carry an ST7735R or ST7735B with other supply ranges; these values are for the ST7735S.
